text: This report recommends approving procurement of required cable for the Relocation of Dufferin Sub-Station project from TOC Logistics Inc ("TOC"). Quotes were requested and received by three (3) suppliers, the recommendation is to approve procurement of cable meeting the requirements and specifications indicated.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the procurement of cable from TOC Logistics Inc. for the Relocation of Dufferin Sub-Station project in the amount of $681,465.78 but excludes HST; this being the lowest acceptable quote received.
